adds.title: Goa Government - Model Transgender Welfare Board (2025)
adds.summary: On May 7, 2025 Goa constituted a 14-member Model Transgender Welfare Board headed by the Chief Secretary under the Transgender Persons (Protection of Rights) Act, 2019 and Rules of 2020 to oversee implementation of welfare schemes and safeguard transgender persons' rights in healthcare, education, employment, and housing.
